{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for any sentinel values or implausible ages (e.g., negative, extremely high)
outliers = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_age'] < 0) | (sales_df['customer_age'] > 120)]

# Check the range of ages
total_customers = len(sales_df)
valid_customers = len(sales_df.dropna())
outlier_count = len(outliers)

# Display the outlier ages
outlier_ages = outliers['customer_age'].unique()

outliers, total_customers, valid_customers, outlier_count, outlier_ages"}
